title: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: Introduction

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane formerly named Argentum, then Mirrodin, remade as Phyrexia's new home world.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Constantly evolving force that subdivided into five factions tied to the five forms of mana.

entities.name: Mirran resistance
entities.description: Mirrans who resist the Phyrexian factions.

events.summary: The plane once named Argentum, then Mirrodin, is transformed again and receives a third name.
events.quote: radical change has visited this world again, and now it bears a third name

events.summary: Exposed to the planar core's mana, Phyrexia grows rapidly and divides into five mana-aligned factions.
events.quote: Phyrexia underwent accelerated growth, but it also subdivided

relations.note: New Phyrexia is Phyrexia's new home world.
